mechaber.en: Prohibition of wearing shoes for a mourner. And it contains 5 seifim. A mourner is forbidden to wear shoes — specifically of leather; but a shoe of cloth, reed, hair, or wood is permitted, for a shoe is only of leather; and if of wood covered with leather — forbidden.
